3x3 Alg Book

Every algorithm in Cube Coach's database: 1,140 algorithms for 228 cases, across F2L (all four slots), OLL, PLL, COLL, CMLL and Winter Variation. Hold the cube with yellow on top and green in front. Each one was run on a simulated cube to check that it solves its case.

For OLL, PLL and most of F2L, the first algorithm in each case is the one cubers voted highest on SpeedCubeDB; the rest follow in the order collected. Setup: do it on a solved cube held yellow on top, green in front, and you get exactly the case in the picture. A turn in brackets before an algorithm, like (U), means turn the top first so the case matches the picture. Search by name or number, or type moves (like R U R' U') to find every case that uses them. Tap Drill to learn new cases one at a time (each new one, then everything learned so far from memory) or to practise ones you know. Tags show what an algorithm needs: R U only is easiest on the hands; back face, bottom face and cube rotations are usually slower.

What the letters mean

A letter alone turns that side clockwise as you look at it. A ' turns it the other way, a 2 turns it twice. Lower-case letters turn two layers. x, y and z turn the whole cube in your hands.
